instr: Packing: fit all the pieces into the board so that every square is covered and no pieces overlap.
clue: Fill the whole board with all the pieces, without overlaps. Choose a piece (click it or press its number), turn it with “Turn” (or the R key) if needed, then click the board square where the piece's dot should go. To move a placed piece, click it on the board to take it back. Press Start when ready.
no_fit: The piece does not fit there.
